collection.title: Citroen C-Zero 2010 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C-Zero 2010 - 2019 requires a 26" wiper blade. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this C-Zero which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
